beats: Hook: on one five-qubit chip some qubits' gates fail several times as often as others' (line_qc_five_chairs: five identical chairs, two wobbly). You have a one-qubit program: where does it go (line_qc_one_guest_best_chair)? And if the program needs all five (line_qc_full_table)? Cast for QC02-02 to QC02-05: the head waiter = the compiler, the chairs = physical qubits, the five guests (top-knot bun and striped scarf; flat cap and cardigan; headband and round collar; curly hair and roll-neck; braid and dungarees) = program qubits; the technician from QC02-01 = the hardware side.

Three constraints (p13, 28:12-28:56): noise, few native gates, sparse connections; this part takes the first, QC02-03 the second, QC02-04 and QC02-05 the third (code: a three-line list on the taped p13).

The calibration table (p14, redrawn as lettering, credit Murali et al., ASPLOS 2019; 29:01-32:26): every gate and every connected pair is measured, chair by chair (line_qc_chair_inspector); single-qubit errors around 1 in 1,000, two-qubit around 1 in 100 in the 2019 data; much better today (32:00-32:54; figures through FACTS.md first).

Why two-qubit gates are worse: doing something together is harder than doing it alone (line_qc_three_legged_race), and her reason (Q24-05 04:30-05:21, clip): a qubit linked to two neighbours is a common friend who leaks what one says to the other (line_qc_common_friend).

Not all qubits are equal (32:54-33:47, clip): manufactured qubits vary like cups thrown to one design (line_qc_potter_cups); ions and neutral atoms of one kind are identical by nature (QC02-01's line_qc_built_vs_found, right half).

Noise-aware mapping (34:40-35:58, clip 34:40-35:07): a one-qubit program takes the best qubit (line_qc_one_guest_best_chair); a five-qubit program must use all five, so the busiest program qubits get the best hardware and the quiet ones the weak (line_qc_full_table). The student question at 33:47-34:40: her answer only.
Takeaway: placement is the compiler's first lever against noise; next, the few gates a chip can speak (QC02-03).
Cover (line_qc_cover_qc02_02; for the X post and thumbnails, not a film beat): the head waiter pulls out the one sturdy chair for a guest, past two wobbly ones.
